97421.overview: This game is an art tool, in which players can create their own anime girls or boys and print them as stickers. Before starting on the design, the player selects the framework characteristics such as body shape. After establishing the character build, the player proceeds to make cosmetic changes to the face including hair, eyes, brows, nose, mouth, and head shape as well as facial expressions, accessories, clothes, screen backgrounds and patterns, and speech bubbles. In addition to a custom character, the player can also create a custom anime animal or object.
